spanish: Y si minjá sobre la plancha tu ofrenda, sólet amasada en el aceite, ázima será.

findings.issue: Common noun (H4503, feminine singular absolute) is left as the transliteration minjá instead of Spanish.
Common noun (H5560, feminine singular absolute) is left as the transliteration sólet instead of Spanish.
Qal passive participle of mix/mingle is rendered amasada, which can add kneading beyond the lemma.

notes: Y si, sobre la plancha, tu ofrenda, en el aceite, and ázima será match the other tokens in order, definiteness, person, and number.
